about_the_game:
Embrace the Art of Wandering

Journey through a breathtaking world where wandering leads to wonder—a place where creativity and exploration intertwine. This hand-crafted open realm invites you to discover its secrets at your own pace, with no dangers to evade or countdowns to race against. Here, your only mission is to experience the joy of discovery and express your artistic vision across an untamed landscape.

Create and Explore

Wander through diverse environments from towering mountains to lush valleys, deep seas, and mysterious caves. Gather unique materials across the terrain to craft stunning environmental art installations—balance stones into impossible sculptures, arrange colorful mosaics, or create melodic wind chimes that sing with the breeze.

Find Your Path

There is no wrong way to experience this world. Fish in tranquil waters, mine for rare resources, chop wood for your creations, fly over breathtaking vistas, or restore ancient ruins to their former glory. Scale cliff faces, dive into the depths of the ocean, or find the perfect vantage point to photograph the changing living landscape under dynamic weather. Form bonds with the diverse wildlife that inhabits this peaceful realm. From tiny critters to larger companions, the animals you encounter can be befriended and even domesticated, becoming partners in your exploration. As you explore and discover, you'll earn Inspiration Points and uncover fragments of classic poetry and literature that resonate with your journey.

Personal Sanctuary

All Those Who Wander offers a unique journaling system—a quiet space to process your thoughts in a world free from demands and pressure. Write poetry, reflect on your day, or simply capture your musings in this tranquil setting. Your personal journal private and can be backed up, creating a meaningful record of your reflections as you find peace in this serene world.

A Meditation for the Artistic Soul

All Those Who Wander is more than just a game—it's a meditation, a canvas, and a sanctuary designed for the artistic soul seeking respite from the chaos of everyday life. Take the scenic route and discover the rewards that await those who wander.

name: All Those Who Wander

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 / AMD Radeon HD 7850 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4GB+ VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card

short_description: All Those Who Wander is a peaceful exploration and art-making game set in a vast, forgotten landscape. Gather materials and creating stunning environmental installations. No enemies, no rush—just your creativity and the freedom to get lost in a world that rewards those who take the scenic route.
